The smell of fresh muffins and american cookies, hmmm! As a production worker at Europastry, this smell will already meet you at the car park. You can work here full-time in 3 shifts and get a nice salary of € 16,12. On top of this, the shift bonus can go up to 110%! But that's not all.... As a true biscuit lover you may eat cookies during your breaks! 🍪

What we offer
- A hourly wage of €16,12 per hour!
- Shift allowance
- Grow opportunities to operator!
- Eating the cookies during your break, yummm
- Travel expenses from 0,25 cent per kilometer
- A job in 3 or 5 shifts

Who you are
To keep the factory running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a production worker:

- You speak Dutch or English.
- You have your own transport to get to Steenbergen.
- You are full time available.
- You are available for 3 or 5 shifts.

What will you do
As a production worker at Europastry, it is your responsibility to produce the delicious biscuits. 🍩 You will weigh out the right kilos of raw materials for the machine, or add chocolate chips here and there. Of course, the biscuits have to be packed after production. You start packing the biscuits at lightning speed. Just close a box, put it on the conveyor belt and that's it! At the end of your shift, you clean your workplace so that your colleagues in the next shift can start. Is everything going super well? Then you could even advance to the role of operator!

Your workingtimes are:

- 🕕 06:00 - 14:00u
- 🕑14:00 - 22:00u
- 🌙 22:00 - 06:00u

Where will you work
As a production worker, you will work at Europastry in Steenbergen. Here they make the most delicious biscuits and muffins for MC Donald's, KFC and Lidl. The next time you eat one of these biscuits or muffins, you may have made it yourself! 🧁Furthermore, there is a close and friendly atmosphere on the shop floor at Europastry. Everyone knows each other, and you will very quickly get to know all your new nice colleagues too! #baanrader

DHL Supply Chain Weert – Full-time (40 hours)

"Every day is different, and you help keep the warehouse running." – DHL colleague

As a Warehouse Employee, you help with the daily work in the warehouse. You make sure products are received, checked and moved in the right way. You work together with your team to keep the warehouse safe and organised.

Your daily tasks include:

- Receive and check incoming goods
- Pick and pack customer orders
- Scan products with a hand scanner
- Register products in the warehouse system
- Check products for damage or mistakes
- Report problems to your Team Leader
- Help your colleagues when needed
- Keep your workplace clean and safe

We are looking for someone who likes to work in a warehouse and enjoys working in a team.

You have:

- Basic logistics knowledge (preferred)
- English skills (A/B)
- Basic computer skills
- Experience with a scanner is a plus
- Good attention to detail
- A positive and motivated attitude
- The ability to work alone and with a team
- An EPT certificate is a plus, or you are willing to get one

Do you know those delicious American Cookies at McDonalds and KFC? Have you always wanted to know the secret behind their recipe? Nice! Because now you can! If you start working as a production employee! Do you want to work with a salary of €33,85 per hour (shift allowance included)? Great! It's possible at Europastry in Steenbergen!

What we offer
- A nice salary of €16,12 gross per hour
- Higher hourly wage after 26 weeks - €16,99!
- Shift allowances between 38% and 110%!
- Travel expenses from 0,25 cent per kilometer
- Possibility to get a fixed contract
- Possibility to grow within the company

Who you are
To keep the factory running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a production worker:

- You speak Dutch or English;
- You have your own transport to get to Steenbergen;
- You are full time available;
- You are available for 5 shifts.

What will you do
As a production employee at Europastry you work at the beginning of the cookie line. You are responsible for collecting and preparing all resources. Think of flour, butter and sugar! Then you weigh everything. And get everything ready for the batter. The batter for the cookies and muffins is made in large kettles. You also help with packing and cleaning work. The work is physically challenging. For example, you are busy lifting bags of ingredients and large baking trays on a daily basis. So, overall a lot of things to do!

You can work in 3 or 5 shifts:

- 🕕 06:00 - 14:00 uur
- 🕑14:00 - 22:00 uur
- 🌙 22:00 - 06:00 uur.

Where will you work
Now you are of course curious where you will be working? The tastiest company in Steenbergen of course! Everyone here knows each other. You will work here as a production employee at the cookie factory Europastry. Here they make cookies and muffins for large companies such as McDonalds, KFC and Lidl. Delicious! Wonderful to work with, isn't it?!  #baanrader

About the function
A job is to operate a CNC Daewoo/Puma 240 lathe with a Fanuc control system. 
The main tasks include setting up, operating, and monitoring the CNC machine, machining metal components (mainly steel and stainless steel) according to technical drawings and tolerances, and performing quality checks using standard measuring tools (caliper, micrometer, etc.).
The operator will be responsible for changing tools, loading and adjusting programs in the Fanuc control when necessary, and reporting any deviations or technical issues to the supervisor.
About the company
A specialist in process technology with decades of experience delivering fully integrated systems for handling powders, granules, and pellets. Known for in-house engineering, high efficiency, and solutions tailored to the food, feed, dairy, and chemical industries. Recognized for innovation, reliability, and end-to-end control.
What we need
Experience with CNC turning and Fanuc, experience with work in a similar environment is a plus. Speaking English (B1 level), reading technical drawings is a must.
